t: Signature Formal Verification Tools: What Formal Verification Is: Proof Instead of Testing
title: Signature Formal Verification Tools: What Formal Verification Is: Proof Instead of Testing
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigProof bench, Manon's original verification design. It mirrors the specify-prove-check pipeline but every proof carries a trust manifest — which properties, which configuration, which assumptions. The Signature design makes the assumptions as prominent as the theorem: a proof is only as strong as its fine print.
key_facts: Proof of absence for proven properties
